legalSummary: Controller: Instal Berrozpe S.L. We use the details you provide to answer your enquiry and, if requested, prepare a quote. The legal basis is taking pre-contractual steps you request or our legitimate interest in answering general enquiries.

Vercel hosts the site and processes the form; Resend delivers the message and Google Workspace receives it in the company mailbox. The full policy explains these providers’ processing and possible international transfers.

The enquiry is kept while it is being handled and afterwards for applicable legal periods. In Workspace, messages remain until manually deleted; no automatic deletion rule is currently configured. Resend states that email data and logs are retained for 30 days while the account is active.
